project_identity.name: Chutex Health Redesign
project_identity.mission: Transform a boring beige medical app into a Premium, High-Trust, Clinical-Tech experience.
project_identity.core_philosophy: Warm Precision. Trust is built through clarity and aesthetic excellence, not just beige backgrounds.

dark.name: Deep Ocean Monitoring
dark.description: Uses deep slate/navy backgrounds with electric blue glowing data points. Best for low-light monitoring and professional feel.

light.name: Swiss Clinical
light.description: Abandoning 'Beige'. Uses Stark White (#FFFFFF) and Cool Grey (#F1F5F9) with deep indigo text. No muddy mid-tones.

headings.note: Use larger than usual sizes. 32px -> 40px for Hero stats.

glassmorphism.style: blur(20px) + low opacity background + thin white border

shadows.style: Soft, diffused, colored shadows. No hard black shadows.

layout_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid - Asymmetrical. Hero Vitals (Large) + Quick Actions (Small squares).
layout_strategy.navigation: Floating Dock (Bottom) or Minimal Tab Bar with glowing active state.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Double the current padding. Minimum 24px padding on containers.

buttons.primary: Full width or Pill shape. Gradient Background. White Text. Bold.
buttons.secondary: Glass effect or Outline. Primary Text.

cards.style: Glass or Solid Surface. 24px Radius. 1px Border (very subtle).
cards.content: Left aligned mostly. Big Data numbers on right or top-left.

icons.style: Size 24px usually. Active = Filled + Color. Inactive = Outline + Grey.

images.description: Abstract Blue Tech Fluid - Use for Login/Splash background with overlay.
Active Senior Man - Use for 'Welcome' or Profile header.
Swirling Data Pattern - Use for 'Computing/Processing' states or subtle dashboard header bg.

implementation_steps: 2. UPDATE COLORS: Refactor `/app/frontend/src/constants/colors.ts` with the new Dark/Light palettes defined above.
3. CREATE UI KITS: Build atomic `Card.js`, `Button.js`, `ScreenContainer.js` in `/components/ui/` implementing the Glass/Neomedical look.
4. REFACTOR SCREENS: Go screen by screen (Login -> Dashboard -> Details) applying the new Layout Strategy.
5. ADD MOTION: Use `react-native-reanimated` for entering screens and pulsing SOS buttons.
universal_guidelines: NO FUNCTIONAL CHANGES. Keep all logic, just wrap in new UI.
ACCESSIBILITY IS PARAMOUNT. High contrast text always.
USE 'StyleSheet.create' but mimic the Tailwind spacing scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48).
AVOID 'BEIGE' AT ALL COSTS. Even if the user asks for 'warm', give them 'Warm White' or 'Sunset Gradient', not 'Beige'.
